name: Texas Instruments BQ25186 Battery Charger
description: The `bq25186` component lets you configure and monitor the Texas Instruments BQ25186 1-cell battery charger and power-path IC over the [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) ([datasheet](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq25186.pdf)). The hub writes the charging, thermal and power-path configuration to the IC and reads its status registers at `update_interval`; the `binary_sensor` and `text_sensor` platforms report that status, the `button` platform triggers the IC's reset and ship modes, and the `switch` platform drives the `/PG/GPO` pin.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I2C address of the device. Default: `0x6A`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the I²C bus.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: How often to read the status registers that feed the binary and text sensors. Every read also serves the I²C watchdog, see `watchdog` below. Default: `60s`.

config_entries.label: Battery Uvlo
config_entries.description:
**Required — set at least one of:** `ts`, `charging`, `charge_done`, `ilim`, `vdppm`, `vindpm`, `thermreg`, `power_good`, `vin_ovp`, `battery_uvlo`, `safety_timer_flag`, `wake1_flag`, `wake2_flag`, `ts_flag`, `ilim_flag`, `vdppm_flag`, `vindpm_flag`, `thermreg_flag`, `vin_ovp_flag`, `battery_uvlo_flag`, `battery_ocp_flag`.

Battery undervoltage lockout. One of `3.0v`, `2.8v`, `2.6v`, `2.4v`, `2.2v`, `2.0v`. Default: `3.0v`.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used to reference this BQ25186 hub from other components.

config_entries.label: Autowake
config_entries.description: Auto-wake timer. One of `0.5s`, `1s`, `2s`, `4s`. Default: `1s`.

config_entries.label: Battery Ocp Limit
config_entries.description: Battery over-current protection limit. One of `500ma`, `1000ma`, `1500ma`, `3000ma`. Default: `3000ma`.

config_entries.label: Battery Regulation Voltage
config_entries.description: Battery regulation voltage, in 10 mV steps from `3.5V` to `4.65V`; a value between steps is rejected. Default: `4.2V`.

config_entries.label: Charge Enabled
config_entries.description: Enable or disable charging. Default: `true`.

config_entries.label: Configure On Boot
config_entries.description: Apply the configuration to the IC on boot. If `false`, the configuration can be applied later with the [`bq25186.apply_configuration` action](https://esphome.io/components/bq25186/#bq25186-apply_configuration-action), for example to avoid rewriting the same configuration after every reboot or to delay the I²C traffic until other components are up. Default: `true`.

config_entries.label: Disable Vdppm
config_entries.description: Disable VDPPM. Default: `false`.

config_entries.label: Double Timer During Dpm
config_entries.description: Double the safety timer during DPM. Default: `false`.

config_entries.label: Enable Push Button
config_entries.description: Enable the push button input. Default: `true`.

config_entries.label: Fast Charge Current
config_entries.description: Fast charge current from `5mA` to `1A`, in 1 mA steps up to `35mA` and 10 mA steps from `40mA`; a value between steps is rejected. Default: `10mA`.

config_entries.label: Flash Charging Mode
config_entries.description: Enable flash charging mode (behavior undocumented in the datasheet). Default: `false`.

config_entries.label: Hw Reset Requires Vin
config_entries.description: Require VIN for hardware reset. Default: `false`.

config_entries.label: Input Current Limit
config_entries.description: Input current limit. One of `50ma`, `100ma`, `200ma`, `300ma`, `400ma`, `500ma`, `665ma`, `1050ma`. Default: `500ma`.

config_entries.label: Long Press Duration
config_entries.description: Long press duration for the push button. One of `5s`, `10s`, `15s`, `20s`. Default: `10s`.

config_entries.label: Mask Bat Interrupt
config_entries.description: Mask battery interrupt. Default: `false`.

config_entries.label: Mask Charge Status Interrupt
config_entries.description: Mask charge status interrupt. Default: `true`.

config_entries.label: Mask Ilim Interrupt
config_entries.description: Mask ILIM interrupt. Default: `true`.

config_entries.label: Mask Pg Interrupt
config_entries.description: Mask PG interrupt. Default: `false`.

config_entries.label: Mask Treg Interrupt
config_entries.description: Mask TREG interrupt. Default: `true`.

config_entries.label: Mask Ts Interrupt
config_entries.description: Mask TS interrupt. Default: `false`.

config_entries.label: Mask Vindpm Interrupt
config_entries.description: Mask VINDPM interrupt. Default: `false`.

config_entries.label: Precharge Is Iterm
config_entries.description: Use precharge current as termination current. Default: `false`.

config_entries.label: Push Button Long Press Action
config_entries.description: Long press action. One of `none`, `hardware_reset`, `ship_mode`, `shutdown_mode`. Default: `ship_mode`.

config_entries.label: Recharge Threshold
config_entries.description: Recharge threshold. One of `100mv`, `200mv`. Default: `100mv`.

config_entries.label: Safety Timer
config_entries.description: Safety timer duration. One of `3h`, `6h`, `12h`, `disabled`. Default: `6h`.

config_entries.label: Sys Mode
config_entries.description: System mode. One of `normal`, `battery_only`, `floating_off`, `pulldown_off`. Default: `normal`.

config_entries.label: System Regulation
config_entries.description: SYS regulation target. One of `battery_tracking`, `4.4v`, `4.5v`, `4.6v`, `4.7v`, `4.8v`, `4.9v`, `pass_through`. Default: `4.5v`.

config_entries.label: Termination Percent
config_entries.description: Termination current as a percentage of fast charge current. One of `disabled`, `5%`, `10%`, `20%`. Default: `10%`.

config_entries.label: Thermal Regulation
config_entries.description: Thermal regulation threshold. One of `100c`, `80c`, `60c`, `disabled`. Default: `100c`.

config_entries.label: Ts Auto Function
config_entries.description: Enable TS automatic function. Default: `true`.

config_entries.label: Ts Cold
config_entries.description: TS cold threshold. One of `0c`, `3c`, `5c`, `-3c`. Default: `0c`.

config_entries.label: Ts Cool Disable
config_entries.description: Disable cool behavior. Default: `false`.

config_entries.label: Ts Hot
config_entries.description: TS hot threshold. One of `60c`, `65c`, `50c`, `45c`. Default: `60c`.

config_entries.label: Ts Ichg
config_entries.description: TS charge current reduction. One of `0.5x`, `0.2x`. Default: `0.5x`.

config_entries.label: Ts Vrcg
config_entries.description: TS regulation voltage offset. One of `-100mv`, `-200mv`. Default: `-100mv`.

config_entries.label: Ts Warm Disable
config_entries.description: Disable warm behavior. Default: `false`.

config_entries.label: Vindpm Mode
config_entries.description: Input voltage dynamic power management mode. One of `battery_tracking`, `4.5v`, `4.7v`, `disabled`. Default: `4.5v`.

config_entries.label: Vlowv
config_entries.description: Precharge to fast charge battery voltage transition threshold (VLOWV) from which the device charges the battery at the fast charge current. One of `3.0v`, `2.8v`. Default: `3.0v`.

config_entries.label: Wake1 Timer
config_entries.description: Wake1 timer selection. One of `300ms`, `1s`. Default: `300ms`.

config_entries.label: Wake2 Timer
config_entries.description: Wake2 timer selection. One of `2s`, `3s`. Default: `2s`.

config_entries.label: Watchdog
config_entries.description: The I²C watchdog. When the bus stays quiet for the chosen period the IC restores its power-on configuration, and the hardware reset variants also power cycle the system. Every status read resets the watchdog, so `update_interval` must be shorter than the period. One of `disabled`, `160s_software_reset`, `160s_hardware_reset`, `40s_hardware_reset`. Default: `disabled`.

config_entries.label: Watchdog 15S Enable
config_entries.description: Perform a hardware reset when no I²C transaction follows within 15 s of VIN being connected. Requires an `update_interval` shorter than `15s`. Default: `false`.
